attchmntText: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: INOX Wind Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported a profit of 6,151 Lakhs for the quarter and 13,302 Lakhs for the half year. Shri Saibaba Vutukuri was appointed as Managing Director of the Wind Business for the INOXGFL Group, effective 14 November 2026. Shri Sanjeev Agarwal resigned as Chief Executive Officer on 13 November 2026, citing personal reasons, and will serve as an Advisor until 31 December 2026. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the grant of 1,45,006 stock options under the Employee Stock Option Scheme 2024 to eligible employees. The Board meeting concluded at 04:15 P.M. on 13 November 2026.

attchmntText: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Inox Wind Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue was Rs 1,378 cr, up 58% quarter on quarter. EBITDA was Rs 238 cr with a margin of approximately 17%. Profit before tax was Rs 103 cr, up 8% quarter on quarter. Cash profit after tax was Rs 165 cr, up 8% quarter on quarter. The company secured orders aggregating to 350 MW from PSUs and IPP in Q2 FY27. Inox Green completed payment for the transfer of Wind World India’s 4.5 GW wind O&M business. Inox Green raised Rs 300 cr through a qualified institutional placement. The order book stands at approximately 3.8 GW as on October 2026. The company guided for revenue of approximately Rs 7,500 cr and an EBITDA margin of approximately 20% for FY28.

attchmntText: Inox Wind Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Investors Meetings to be held on November 16, 2026 and November 17, 2026
voiceSummary: Inox Wind Limited announces that its representatives will attend investor conferences organized by JM Financial and Avendus Spark in Mumbai. The JM Financial event is scheduled for 16th November, 2026, and the Avendus Spark event is scheduled for 17th November, 2026. Both meetings will be conducted as group or one-on-one sessions. An investor presentation on financial results for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026, will be shared at these conferences. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared during these events. The schedule may undergo changes due to exigencies on the part of investors or the company. This information is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
